author: github@nwdxlgzs
features: Files and folders move by dropping onto a directory tab, folder, breadcrumb or parent button; multiple selections are preserved and preview tabs reject drops
Ctrl+X and context cut/paste move directories outward and across tabs; only successfully moved clipboard items are consumed, skipped/partial cross-mount moves remain recoverable
Directory destination picker supports parent/root traversal, explicit typed destinations and paged folder listing
Overflow menu has concise page-level groups; file actions stay with files, sibling-folder navigation spans the address bar and tracks desktop resizing
PDF.js text layer applies its font-height, horizontal-scale and rotation metrics through zoom; real pointer selection verified for PDF, Word and PPT
Presentation selection follows visual reading rows while retaining renderer transforms and original run IDs; native and toolbar copying include bounded rendered image crops in HTML and plain text
Presentation controls use deliberately aligned compact rows down to 240px; mobile, dark theme, fullscreen and no-Wasm fallback regressions passed
verificationAdjustments: The preview regression now asserts the intended file is selected before opening its tab; hidden recycled list rows are checked by visibility; multi-drag uses a distinct destination tab
validationBoundaries: No native macOS run, as requested; no new native IE11 or Windows 7 run; ES5/missing-API and no-Wasm Chromium fallback checks passed
Silurus 0.89.10 does not expose authored PowerPoint animation/transition playback; these effects are not implemented
Office basic/no-Wasm layout remains a text/table/common-image fallback; full desktop Office fidelity is not claimed
No physical LAN throughput benchmark for this UI patch; no GPU backend introduced
